positive_constraints: Preserve Bit's compact wheeled robot silhouette and toy-like proportions in every expression.
Keep the red accent system: antenna, face marks, circular joints, and wheel trim.
Maintain the white shell, black face screen, and red digital features across all expression variants.
Keep the isolated white background and soft pale grey ground shadow where present.
Use this image as the canonical reference for Bit's expression set in the bit-and-bot pack.
negative_constraints: Do not give Bit blue accents or any other character's palette.
Do not redesign Bit as a sleek drone, humanoid android, or menacing machine.
Do not remove the wheels or change the two-wheel lower body.
Do not add busy backgrounds, non-Bit accessories, or extra props not in the image.
Do not swap or invent expression labels not supported by this reference sheet.
